blocks.body:
## Technical summary

The scan found **6455 observed discontinuities** across **82 of 141 governed lanes**. It excludes **2611 normal FX weekend closures**. Use the lane table to prioritise symbols; use the detailed table to inspect each missing interval.

## What counts as a gap

An observed gap is a break between consecutive governed bars longer than two expected intraday intervals, or longer than three D1 intervals. FX Friday-to-Sunday/Monday closures are excluded. `Validation missing` is the independent, calendar-aware count stored by the lane validator, so it may differ from the visual discontinuity count.

## Prioritise lanes by the largest break

The chart ranks the 12 most consequential continuity breaks. The table that follows has one row per affected symbol/timeframe and is sorted by the same measure for exact lookup.

## Inspect the largest breaks

This exact lookup table lists up to the three largest observed breaks in each affected lane. The first table retains the complete observed-gap count. Neither table infers or interpolates price data.

## Limits of this report

The report is a point-in-time snapshot of the current estate. It reports continuity, not price correctness. A lane can be continuous while still requiring provenance or price-quality review; conversely, expected market closures are intentionally not counted as missing history.

## Next steps

Prioritise rows with material validator gaps or the largest observed intervals. Re-run this report after scheduler catch-up or a controlled historical import to confirm that the specific interval has closed.
